title: Sheehan visits Ingo Swann at his New York apartment
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Sheehan visits Ingo Swann at his New York apartment, about 1970s at New York City, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan says that in the 1970s he went to see Ingo Swann, a man known for psychic work, at his apartment in New York City. Sheehan says Swann led him all the way upstairs and out onto the roof. He tells it as part of his own path into the world of psychics and UFOs, a meeting that, if true, put him in contact with a key figure in that world.
